consequence.statement: ClusterSecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. Unless the operator rewrites all objects and updates status.storedVersions, the stored objects still depend on v1beta1 when a later release removes that version.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration that rewrites all ClusterSecretStore objects, then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions of the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD moves from v1beta1 to v1 (0.15.0 → 0.16.0). Existing ClusterSecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten, so a storage version migration and an update of status.storedVersions are needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
